content.short: AXUS Protocol is a TON DeFi pawn and lending app where users can borrow against tokens without KYC.
content.description: AXUS Protocol presents itself as a decentralized DeFi pawnshop on TON. Its site describes using tokens as collateral to receive AXP or TON, with on-chain execution, no KYC, and a fast borrowing flow. The product is a collateralized lending service rather than a staking pool or ordinary wallet. AXUS Protocol - умный DeFi-ломбард, принимающий любые токены в залог. Получи AXP или TON за мемкоины, аирдропы, старые активы. The product surface includes резюме, проблема, решение: axus, and как это работает.
